product_rsc.title: Glow Blend
product_rsc.description: GLOW Blend contains a nominal 70 mg per vial: 50 mg GHK-Cu, 10 mg BPC-157 and 10 mg TB-500. The source identifies the TB-500 component as Ac-LKKTETQ, an acetylated seven-residue fragment, not full-length thymosin beta-4. Match the lot to its analytical report. For laboratory research only.
